title: Which Tour Is Right for You (With Real Reviews)
why: Warm leads choosing between NKST products: picks a tour by goal, backed by real guest review lines from the vault.
hook_options: Two hours, four hours, or a full day?
Pick your swamp tour in 10 slides.
First time, photos, or history? Here's your tour.
caption: Two hours if it's your first time or you're short on time. Four if you want photos and real quiet. The full Whitney Plantation day if history matters to your group. Still stuck? Text us at 504-571-9975. #NewOrleansSwampTour #KayakNOLA #NOLATravel #ManchacSwamp

slides.headline: Two hours, four hours, or a full day?
slides.body: How to choose, plus what real guests said after paddling with us.

slides.headline: "What a peaceful, gorgeous and relaxing tour."
slides.body: A real guest review. More where that came from.

slides.headline: The 2-hour Manchac tour.
slides.body: Our most popular. Right for first-timers, families, and anyone short on time. Four departures a day.

slides.headline: "For our first time kayaking, it was perfect."
slides.body: Most guests have never kayaked. We teach you on shore before we launch.

slides.headline: The 4-hour Extended Manchac.
slides.body: Deeper and slower. Built for photographers and anyone who wants to fully unplug. Fall is its best season.

slides.headline: "We had the river to ourselves."
slides.body: That's what small groups buy you. Twelve guests max on public tours.

slides.headline: Whitney Plantation plus swamp combo.
slides.body: A full day: a guided tour of Whitney Plantation, one of the country's most important slavery museums, then an afternoon paddle.
